name: BASED
rootCause: The DeFi liquidity farming anonymous project BASED officially announced that it would redeploy the pledge pool. The official tweeted that a hacker tried to freeze "Pool1" permanently, but the attempt failed, and "Pool1" will continue as planned. The mortgage funds and BASED tokens are currently safe.
